== Biography ==
Silas was born about 1825.<ref>Based on death 1875 age 50.</ref> He was the eldest son of Samuel Glasgow and lived at Killycurragh as of 1855.

On 23 Aug 1855 at Draperstown Meetinghouse, he married Isabella Loughlin of Cavanreagh, only daughter of James Loughlin, farmer.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/5860f23250776 Silas Glasgow, Isabella Loughlin, 23 Aug 1855, Magherafelt] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>
<ref>[https://www.britishnewspaperarchive.co.uk/viewer/bl/0001318/18550906/045/0002 "Married"], ''Londonderry Standard'' - Thursday 06 September 1855</ref>

He passed away 5 Jul 1875 at Killycurragh due to heart disease. He was a farmer. Attended by Bella Glasgow.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/ea82857225944 Silas Glasgow, 1875, Cookstown, 50] at Irish Civil Registration - Deaths</ref>

His middle name was given as Ebenezer on son James Alexander's marriage. I haven't seen it on any other records though.

There is also a Silas Ebenezer Weir, b 16 May 1869 at Loy, Cookstown. Perhaps "Ebenezer" and "Silas" comes from the Weir side -- maybe that is his mother's name?

The death of Silas Glasgow was registered on 5 July 1875 in Cookstown, aged 50.<ref>[https://geni.nidirect.gov.uk/search/death GRONI civil death index], Silas Glasgow, 5 July 1875, aged 50, Cookstown registration district, D/1875/99/1009/6/133.</ref>
